cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. When I said the evening would flow, I meant this kitchen flood.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Water is now the dominant topic. A remarkably accurate forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said we'd need to open up. The plumbing listened first.
